$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-26-batch-u/2026-10-26-batch-u.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

source.operator_quote: are these handbook compliant - ie standardized, observable, scalable, accurate and understandable (simple no scope creep) then proceed

decisions.question: An exception that lists the "only permitted building type" (RS Exception 14): does its list close the base type list?
decisions.recommendation: (A) Rule before night D: a Chapter 900 exception whose clause names the only permitted building type(s) closes the base type list for every other class. Those classes read not_evaluated:no_candidate with a disclosure, the same honest answer as the RD semi, and read prohibited only once G4 is ruled. Applied as an M-75 keying of each such exception unit, with its own M-321 pre-registration; night D waits for that round. Rule text changed (disclosed): a dated note on M-34.

decisions.question: RM Exceptions 253 / 475: a condition that qualifies only the townhouse
decisions.recommendation: Recorded as recommended, DEFERRED (no build until Phase 2/3 is complete; does not gate night D): an M-75 correction that splits the unit so the fronting condition binds only the townhouse, pre-registered under M-321. Cost: 2 units, 10 sample lots. Rule text changed: none.

decisions.question: The houseplex cites 600.60.40(1)(B) on lots outside the Sixplex Overlay
decisions.recommendation: Recorded as recommended, DEFERRED (no build until Phase 2/3 is complete; does not gate night D): rule Q-E, 600.60 units bind only lots in the Sixplex Overlay, with a gate in applies() under its own PLAN; the citation then drops on those lots and no word moves. Rule text changed (disclosed, at the build): the Q-E line of layer2-scope.json:2 from "drafted for ruling" to ruled.

decisions.question: The description of 10.20.20.40(2)#whole contradicts its keying
decisions.recommendation: Recorded as recommended, DEFERRED (no build until Phase 2/3 is complete; does not gate night D): an M-75 description correction (wording only). Cost: one record, 0 values. Rule text changed: none.

decisions.question: The same lots carry a different undecided reason in different classes
decisions.recommendation: Recorded as recommended, DEFERRED (no build until Phase 2/3 is complete; does not gate night D): one reason precedence across classes, a lot-level gate reason such as named_lots_only outranks the class-level no_candidate; a small evaluator change that moves evaluator_version and needs a restamp night. Rule text changed (disclosed, at the build): the precedence comment at evaluate.mjs:814 and a dated note on Spec 68 section 7.5 rule 7.

decisions.question: Oracle B's own permitted() ignores the permission scope
decisions.recommendation: Routed as a card to the Oracle-B lane (give oracle B the same scope rule before any A/B comparison of permitted() is added). No ruling on the build. Rule text changed: none.

decisions.question: 900.3.10(200) (RD): a count limit or a type-list closure?
decisions.recommendation: Read it as a count limit (one house per lot on the named lots), not a type-list closure; it is named_lots_only anyway. Cost: none.

decisions.question: 900.5.10(361)(G) (RT): "only dwelling units located in a townhouse are permitted on the lot"
decisions.recommendation: A closure to townhouse: it names the type through "dwelling units located in a townhouse" and displaces the base type list.

decisions.question: 900.6.10(365)(A) (RM): "only dwelling units in an apartment building and a nursing home are permitted"
decisions.recommendation: A closure to apartment building; the nursing home is a use, not a building type.

decisions.question: 900.6.10(253)(A) and (475)(A) against the deferred USO-Q2
decisions.recommendation: Key the closure now: the detached and semi-detached houseplex classes are not named, so they close. Leave the unit's whole-unit fronting condition untouched, so these lots stay undecided (condition_unknown) until USO-Q2. Cost: none on night-D values.
